chunks: And I said to him: A man forgot the two rakʿahs behind the Maqam of Ibrahim عليه السلام and did not remember until he departed from Makkah.
He said: "Then let him pray them wherever he remembers. And if he remembers them while he is still in the city, then he should not leave until he performs them."

key_terms.اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ: the two rakʿahs of prayer required here
key_terms.اِرْتَحَلَ: departed or set out from the place
key_terms.بِالْبَلَدِ: within the city, meaning Makkah here
key_terms.فَلْيُصَلِّهِمَا: let him perform the two prayers
key_terms.مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: the Station of Ibrahim, the place associated with the tawaf prayer
key_terms.يَقْضِيَهُمَا: to make them up or perform them as missed prayers

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he forgets the two rakʿahs behind Maqam Ibrahim after tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the two rakʿahs of tawaf prayer behind Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام when they are forgotten. If the person remembers after leaving Makkah, he should perform them wherever he remembers; but if he remembers while still in the city, he must not depart until he makes them up.
